verdict.rationale: Bento documents alerts written in plain natural language that compile to trace queries and route to Slack, PagerDuty, email, or webhook. It also groups alert fires into incidents and filters out benign ones. Cost per run and tool failure rates are tracked out of the box, which makes error-rate and cost alerts plausible, but alerting specifically on cost spikes or eval-score drops is only implied. missing for 10: explicit documentation of alert rules for cost spikes and eval-score drops, in-depth alert configuration docs beyond FAQ/marketing copy, independent or hands-on corroboration.
